# `satl tag` { #satl-tag }

Create a tag `TARGET_IMAGE` that refers to `SOURCE_IMAGE`

```console
$ satl tag [OPTIONS] <SOURCE_IMAGE[:TAG]> <TARGET_IMAGE[:TAG]>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>&lt;SOURCE_IMAGE[:TAG]&gt;</code> | The existing local image |
| <code>&lt;TARGET_IMAGE[:TAG]&gt;</code> | The additional reference to point at the same image |

## Global options { #global-options }

Accepted by every `satl` command.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>--host &lt;URL&gt;</code> | Daemon socket to connect to (docker-style URL)<br>Default: <code>unix:///var/run/satl.sock</code><br>Environment: <code>DOCKER_HOST</code> |
| <code>-h, --help</code> | Print help |
| <code>-V, --version</code> | Print version |
